root_cause: Legacy feasibility/clarification layers could still downgrade a canonical executable action into a conversational proposal, causing Luna to ask 'Shall I proceed?' even after the direct-action refactor.
fixes: Canonical action now overrides legacy feasibility routing for normal executable actions.
Executable action no longer enters clarification-only branch.
Late feasibility fallback no longer blocks a canonical executable action.
Natural reply rules explicitly forbid Proceed/Build-it style follow-up language for executable actions.
regression: Build me a premium restaurant website for Milagrina in Ormoc City. You choose the design and build the homepage. -> execute directly.
Expected statuses: Thinking -> Planning -> Choosing the design -> Building your page -> Checking the result.
No Shall I proceed / Ready to build / Build it / Continue.
Expected result: blocks > 0 and verified final reply.
